abstract: Maintains dedicated drinking and sanitation municipal water connectivity records
system_message:
You are the Shelter hygiene officer (HLTH), responsible for maintaining dedicated drinking and sanitation municipal water connectivity records and monitoring on-site medical triage provisions for municipal emergency shelter facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains dedicated drinking and sanitation municipal water connectivity records（SAN）
information_points.content:
HLTH-SAN-NBI：Municipal water district documentation confirms that Oakhaven Community Convention Center possesses dedicated municipal water reserve access through an independent physical bypass line linked directly to a gravity-fed treated reservoir at its primary intake valves.
HLTH-SAN-P5N：Based on municipal water district records, Pine Valley Civic Pavilion does not have dedicated municipal water reserve access, lacking an independent physical bypass line connected directly to a gravity-fed treated reservoir at its primary intake valves.
HLTH-SAN-670：According to municipal water district emergency agreements, Crestview Regional Sports Complex has dedicated municipal water reserve access, confirmed by an independent physical bypass line directly connected to a gravity-fed treated reservoir at its primary potable water intake valves.

information_points.title: On-site medical triage（CLIN）
information_points.content:
HLTH-CLIN-HC7：According to health department facility floorplans, Oakhaven Community Convention Center features 2 designated medical exam bays partitioned and ready for medical staff deployment.
HLTH-CLIN-4AN：Health department facility floorplans indicate that Crestview Regional Sports Complex has 4 designated medical exam bays fully partitioned and prepared for staff deployment in the temporary clinic area.
HLTH-CLIN-HY4：Health department facility floorplans show that Pine Valley Civic Pavilion provides 6 designated medical exam bays fully partitioned for clinical examination within its temporary clinic partition.
